title: 第十一章 梁州城第十二章 庄丁护院
content_zh:
于是岳鹏跟着铁蛋，一路向北，翻山越岭的，直往兑国梁州城来。
不错，就铁蛋一个人在前头走，岳鹏远远的在后头跟着。
就是把这小子当个钓饵，钓出了妖魔鬼怪，豺狼虎豹，就给他练手，杀妖取丹，猎兽扒皮，习练剑炁。
真冒出什么妖魔老怪，他再出手不迟。
不过妖魔老怪也不是煞笔，在这片混的哪个不知道燕子峰剑仙的利害，有事没事招惹北辰一群剑魔是想不开么。
而山岭中的豺狼虎豹，飞禽走兽，大抵又都是肉体凡胎，根本抵不住神罡剑炁一削的，实在也犯不着师兄出来救救。
于是一路上，岳鹏尽看着铁蛋这小子，杀狼杀狗杀豹子的，杀了一路，也逐渐瞧出他的剑路来了。
好吧，其实并没有啥剑路，毕竟才刚入门炼炁的童子么，啥都还没来得及教，基础剑术都不会呢，更遑论剑宗真传的那些绝顶上乘的剑诀剑法。
但铁蛋确实是有天赋的，也不知是还是先天的心怀杀念，还是后天久经磨砺，总之铁蛋确实不似那种寻常小屁孩，杀个人罢了还哭哭闹闹，磨磨蹭蹭的。
他的手特别稳，剑也特别准，指哪儿刺哪儿，一剑必杀，毫无犹疑，再加上北辰剑炁的利害，宰起未结丹的妖魔野兽，自然如屠鸡狗，断毛发一般。
于是岳鹏也知道要教他什么了。
“御剑术。你现在气虚体弱，精血不足，上乘剑诀剑法也使不出威力来，便习练御剑吧。”
岳鹏说着，把手里的木剑一抛，手上剑诀一掐，那木剑便如蜻蜓似当空盘桓，嗖嗖往来穿梭，把路边的树叶刷刷打落下来。
“来，你试试。把那只雀打下来。”
铁蛋抬头看看那轻燕般飞翔的木剑，又看看手里厚重的铁剑。
岳鹏咧着嘴笑，
“重量不妨事的，我炼的是紫霞剑炁才用木剑罢了，我看你这一口神罡剑炁，已淬炼得炉火纯青，应该已经可以御剑了，把剑炁往金铁上一裹便可以了。”
于是铁蛋点点头，把手中剑横持，手掐剑诀，食中二指往剑刃一抹，默念师兄传授的口诀，
“九天乾金，扬布神兵，群邪辟易，太上浩凶，威剑神王，斩邪灭踪，紫气乘天，丹霞赫冲，上极无上，最上之尊，玄之又玄，开玄之祖，太上无极九天玄女如意剑！疾！”
“锃！”

抬手一送，飞剑出鞘，化作一道金光划过天际，刺穿枝头的云雀，顺带着把栽种在驰道旁，成排的合抱之木拦腰斩断。
岳鹏点点头，
“好！果然是个剑种！嗯？怎么又趴下了，起来。”
铁蛋瘫在地上，
“没炁了。”
岳鹏一愣，赶紧给铁蛋把脉检查了一下，也是无语。
好吧，铁蛋的剑道天资悟性果然极高，虽然是炼炁期，已经能使出那些筑基修士都不一定掌握的秘剑了。
但到底是年纪太小，境界太低，身子骨也太虚了，肺腑里就只能憋一口炁。
若是近身厮杀，刺出去还能及时吸还回来反复用倒也罢了，但这要是把握不住一个度，尽数作御剑之用，喷的出去收不回来，那自然如这般精气枯竭，四肢无力，手足发软，瘫成烂泥一般了。
“你身子疲弱，精炁神都不足，现在就要你御剑果然还是太勉强了。哦对了，那铁剑上，我也给上过符箓来着，也算是法器了，你都没筑基，难以驾驭也是寻常之理……”
铁蛋就瞪着他。
岳鹏挠挠头，取出一吊钱塞他怀里，
“好了好了，我不也没教过弟子么，还以为你小子天生剑种，真有那么与众不同的呢，看来也就这样啊，一口炁就不行了，那你还是从简单的开始练起吧。
这些神罡钱是魔宫铸造的宝钱，富含神罡金炁，平时你可以吸纳神罡炁修行，也可以使御剑术，御钱练习，消耗当不会那么大了。”
刚才是谁说重量无所谓的啊！
岳鹏搂着自己的木剑站起来，
“这里离梁州城也不远了，你自个顺着驰道进城就是，天材地宝还是要自己寻着的最好，就算碰不到，增长一番阅历也是好的。
当然金精这种玩意，价值连城，在百姓家里肯定是寻不着的，得往那些豪门大户家里去才捡得到，所以这一关就是你的历练了，试试看，能不能潜进人家府邸里去。
放心，师兄我会先行一步踩点，暗中保护你的。”
他说话声渐行渐远，等话音落时，人影已看不见了。

铁蛋也是无奈，就瘫在地上调息回炁，好一会儿才能爬起来，又走了老远，寻到飞出去插进土里的铁剑拔出来，蹒跚着顺驰道往北，等终于见到梁州府城的城郭，天已渐暗，眼看着要关城门了。
content_en:
So Yue Peng followed Tiedan all the way north, over the mountains and ridges, straight to Duiguo Liangzhou City.
Yes, Tiedan was walking in front alone, with Yue Peng following from a distance.
They used this boy as a bait to catch monsters, monsters, jackals, tigers and leopards, and then trained him to kill monsters to get pills, hunt animals to skin them, and practice swordsmanship.
If some evil monster really appears, it won't be too late for him to take action.
However, the old monster is not evil. Who among the people in this area does not know the advantages and disadvantages of the Yanzifeng Sword Immortal. It is hard to think of provoking a group of sword demons in Beichen for nothing.
As for the wolves, tigers, leopards, birds and beasts in the mountains, most of them have mortal bodies and cannot withstand the sharp blow of Shen Gang's sword. There is really no need for senior brother to come out to save them.
So along the way, Yue Peng watched this kid Tiedan, who killed wolves, dogs and leopards, and gradually saw his sword skills as he killed them all the way.
Well, in fact, there is no swordsmanship. After all, a boy who has just started to practice Qi has not had time to teach anything, and he does not even know basic swordsmanship, let alone those superb swordsmanship and swordsmanship passed down by the Sword Sect.
But Tiedan is indeed gifted. I don’t know if it’s because he is born with the desire to kill or if he has been honed over time. In short, Tiedan is not like that ordinary little kid who just kills someone and still cries and fusses and dawdles.
His hands are extremely steady and his sword is extremely accurate. He can stab wherever he points and kill with one strike without any hesitation. Coupled with the power of Beichen Sword Qi, he can kill demons and beasts that have not formed pills, just like slaughtering chickens and dogs and cutting off their hair.
So Yue Peng also knew what to teach him.
"Sword-controlling skills. You are now weak and weak, with insufficient blood and essence, and the superior sword techniques cannot produce the power, so you should practice sword-controlling."
Yue Peng said, throwing the wooden sword in his hand and pinching the sword secret in his hand. The wooden sword hovered in the air like a dragonfly, swishing back and forth, knocking down the leaves on the roadside.
"Here, try it. Knock that bird down."
Tiedan looked up at the wooden sword flying like a light swallow, and then at the heavy iron sword in his hand.
Yue Peng grinned,
"The weight doesn't matter. I am practicing Zixia Sword Qi, so I use a wooden sword. I see that your Shengang Sword Qi has been tempered to a high level, and you should be able to wield a sword by now. Just wrap the sword Qi in gold and iron."
So Tiedan nodded, held the sword horizontally, pinched the sword formula with his hand, touched the blade of the sword with his two fingers, and silently recited the formula taught by his senior brother.
"Nine heavens dry gold, spreading divine weapons, group of evils and warding off troubles, supreme power and fierceness, mighty sword god king, slaying evil and destroying all traces, purple energy flying in the sky, red clouds soaring, supreme supreme, supreme honor, mysterious and mysterious, ancestor of Kai Xuan, Supreme Wuji Nine Heaven Xuannv Ruyi Sword! Quick!"
"Zhi!"
Raising his hand, the flying sword was unsheathed and turned into a golden light across the sky. It pierced the skylark on the branch and cut off the rows of hugging trees planted beside the road.
Yue Peng nodded,
"Okay! He is indeed a sword type! Huh? Why did he lie down again and get up?"
Tiedan collapsed on the ground,
"No energy left."
Yue Peng was stunned and quickly checked Tiedan's pulse, but was speechless.
Well, Tiedan's swordsmanship talent and understanding are indeed extremely high. Although he is still in the energy refining stage, he can already use secret swords that even foundation-building monks may not master.
But in the end, he was too young, his level of cultivation was too low, and his body and bones were too weak. He could only hold back a breath of Qi in his heart.
If it's a close fight, it's fine if you stab it out and you can suck it back in time and use it again and again. But if you can't grasp the degree and use it as a sword, and it's sprayed out and you can't take it back, then naturally your energy will be exhausted, your limbs will be weak, your hands and feet will become weak, and they will collapse into mud.
"You are weak and lack energy. It is really too reluctant for you to control the sword now. Oh, by the way, I have also put a talisman on the iron sword, which can be regarded as a magical weapon. You have not established a foundation, so it is normal for it to be difficult to control..."
Tiedan just stared at him.
Yue Peng scratched his head and tookPut a bunch of money into his arms,
"Okay, okay, I haven't taught any disciples before. I thought your boy was born with a sword and was really so unique. It seems like that's it. A breath of Qi won't do it, so you should start with simple training.
These Shen Gang coins are treasures forged in the Demon Palace and are rich in Shen Gang's golden energy. You can usually absorb the Shen Gang's energy to practice, or you can practice sword control and money control. The consumption will not be that big. "
Who just said weight doesn’t matter!
Yue Peng stood up holding his wooden sword.
"This is not far from Liangzhou City. Just follow the Chi Road into the city. It's best to find the natural and earthly treasures by yourself. Even if you can't come across them, it's good to gain some experience.
Of course, things like gold essence are extremely valuable and cannot be found in ordinary people's homes. You have to go to the homes of wealthy families to pick them up. So this level is your experience. Try to see if you can sneak into other people's mansions.
Don't worry, senior brother, I will be the first to step in and protect you secretly. "
His voice gradually faded away, and by the time he finished speaking, the figure was no longer visible.
Tiedan was helpless, so he collapsed on the ground and adjusted his breath to regain his energy. It took him a while to get up, and he walked a long way. He found the iron sword that flew out and was inserted into the soil, pulled it out, and staggered along the road to the north. When he finally saw the city walls of Liangzhou Fucheng, it was getting dark and the city gate was about to close.
